family: For every n>=0, the total Boolean function MOD3_n outputs 1 exactly when the Hamming weight of its n-bit input is divisible by 3, including MOD3_0(empty)=1.
theorem: For this fixed uniform polynomial-time family, in NP with the empty witness, every full-B2 circuit computing MOD3_n has at least 2n-3 gates for all n>=2; consequently the liminf of its minimum gate count divided by n is at least 2.
